[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-17p[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]E2: durable ToolRun hand-off and lifecycle control[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A handed-off ToolRun has a durable identity before its caller lets [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]go, stays discoverable, followable, waitable, and stoppable through[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that identity, and always settles to either an authoritative [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]outcome or an explicit, typed uncertainty — built on the existing [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]monitor and proc executors, with no new supervisor.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]tool_e2_durable_handoff.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/tool_e2_durable_handoff.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-17p[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-17p/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Extend the sase-core ToolRun contract for reservation, [/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]adoption, and owner-aware settlement[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]core-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-contract: add reservation with a private launch envelope, an atomic[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]claim, a durable stop request, typed terminal causes, persisted finish [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]diagnostics, the owner log locator, and owner-aware reconcile to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-core ToolRun store and bindings, all additive at wire schema 1, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]then move sase's core revision pin.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hand a ToolRun off to a plain durable proc with sase tool run [bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]-H[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]standalone-handoff[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core-contract[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]standalone-handoff: split the executor so one body serves foreground and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]adopted runs, add the hidden claim-then-run worker and the shared launch[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]module, and ship fail-closed sase tool run -H outside agents over a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plain proc, behind the tool_handoff beta flag.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Reserve the ToolRun when a monitor start hands off a tool run[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]monitor-handoff[dim] · [dim][/dim]after standalone-handoff[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-handoff: when a monitor's proc will run a ToolRun, reserve and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bind it to the monitor before hand-off and run the adopting worker, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]leaving monitor_command, execution_argv, and -f bindings untouched, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fail-open to E1.5 wrapping, behind the same flag.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop, follow, and wait on a ToolRun by id[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]lifecycle-controls[dim] · [dim][/dim]after standalone-handoff[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]lifecycle-controls: add sase tool stop, sase tool show -F/--follow, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase tool wait as ownership-aware facades over the run's execution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]owner, with stop-requested versus stopped reporting and viewer-only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]interruption.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Settle hand-off runs truthfully after crashes and deliver once[bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]settlement[dim] · [dim][/dim]after monitor-handoff, lifecycle-controls[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]settlement: feed owner facts into reconcile, record stop and timeout [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]causes from the owner's termination intent, settle from proc and monitor[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]settlement, publish exactly one notification for proc-owned hand-offs, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and report expired owner logs explicitly.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Prove the hand-off contract end to end and remove the beta [/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]flag[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance-and-adoption[dim] · [dim][/dim]after settlement[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance-and-adoption: extend the ToolRun smoke harness with the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hand-off fault matrix, update docs, the sase_monitor skill source, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the named memory, and remove the tool_handoff flag.[/#D7D7AF]
